$description: The launcher's design tokens (LNPANDY/NX2Apple#1458), W3C Design Tokens Community Group format. tools/design_tokens.py writes frontend/Sources/NXLauncher/Generated/DesignTokens.swift from this file. The launcher is dark only, so every colour has one value.

surface.$description: A card, a sheet, the build footer

surfaceRaised.$description: A control or a notice on a card

separator.$description: A hairline between rows and under the top bar

accent.$description: The cream: the one primary action of a screen, selection and focus

accentOn.$description: Text and symbols on the accent

success.$description: Done, a passed check, a notice's success symbol

default.$description: Every symbol that is not a status or a selection: row, button and header icons. The same as text.secondary

accent.$description: A symbol of something selected or active, nothing else

title.$description: A sheet or wizard title, the library's row title

headline.$description: A section header over a group

bodyStrong.$description: Button labels and emphasised row text

footnote.$description: Group footers, the smallest text there is

height.$description: Every button and dropdown in a row

columnWidth.$description: The trailing control column of a settings row, wide enough for the longest label in every language

leadingSlot.$description: The status dot or symbol slot every row of a group reserves

contentWidth.$description: The readable column of a page of cards

headerIcon.$description: The app icon in a build page's compact header

thumbnail.$description: A game's cover in a row's leading slot, and the slot of every row in that list

console.$description: Console mode, the controller and TV interface read from across a room (big targets, few choices, clear focus). Generated into DS.Console.

largeTitle.$description: A game's title on its page and on the home screen

headline.$description: A section header over a grouped list, a notice title

bodyStrong.$description: A selected segment, a button label, a stat value

callout.$description: Row subtitles, the secondary line under a title

footnote.$description: Stat labels, the hint bar, card captions

gutter.$description: The page's outer margin on a TV

rowHeight.$description: Every row of a grouped list, settings and links alike

topBar.$description: The home screen's top controls: the build, the players, Controllers, Search and the menu

glyph.$description: A controller glyph in the hint bar

buildIcon.$description: The building game's app icon in the top bar

appIcon.$description: The game's app icon on the starting screen

valueBar.$description: The thin bar under a continuous value

stepper.$description: The value stepper's column, wide enough for every language

contentWidth.$description: The content column at its widest

hintBar.$description: The controller hint bar at the bottom of a page

row.$description: A grouped list and its rows

art.$description: A cover on the home screen

focus.$description: A focused cover grows by this, nothing else changes size

artColumn.$description: The share of a page the artwork column takes
